objective: Standard statement: by SAT with sound symmetry breaking, enumerate the connected cubic triple systems that may repeat a point on a line (multiplicities 1 to 3) and are not 2-colourable, untwisted and with one twisted incidence, for small n, up to isomorphism; decompose each along tight cuts and check every piece against ticket A (triple edge, doubled square, Heawood graph, Pfaffian planar or 4-sum braces) and every leaf of the simple ones against the Fano-leaf theorem; enumerate all twisted simple systems on 14 points and show none is a brace. Nearest known result: ticket A; THREEFOLD-SPACES-20261030-001B. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved: SAT census of connected non-2-colourable cubic multi-systems to 10 points (160 untwisted, 2492 twisted classes) matches ticket A on every class, with one non-planar glue brace (the trisum of three cubes, reaching a 35-point space); with the Fano-leaf theorem the knot's three-fold spaces up to 22 points have exactly 7, 13, 19, 21 or 22 points (1, 1, 4, 1, 1 classes), twisted 14, 15, 18, 20, 21, 22; independent SAT at 14 points agrees.
title: Census with doubled incidences
